_comment: Hard caps enforced by bridge/purchases.mjs BEFORE any virtual-card call. Defense-in-depth on top of the pre-funded card's bank ceiling. Edit numbers cautiously — the LLM cannot edit this file at runtime.

tiers._comment: Confirmation requirement by amount. auto = LLM may proceed without operator confirm. voice = standard voice 'yes'/'no' gate. typed = HUD modal where operator types the amount to confirm (anti-injection — voice 'yes' cannot authorise).
